note: Out-of-sample forecasts only: walk-forward refits each January (development) and one refit through 2023-09 (held-back). Realised = volatility of the next 21 trading days, annualised.

model.type: Gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost), 977 trees, depth 2, learning rate 0.1
model.target: log of realised volatility over the next 21 trading days, per ETF
model.inputs: recent realised and range-based volatility (1, 5, 21, 63 days), downside and upside semivariance, overnight gaps, volume, VIX, VIX9D, VIX3M, VVIX, VIX futures slope, each ETF's own implied volatility where CBOE publishes one (9 of 23), days to the next FOMC decision, asset class
model.training: pooled across the 23 ETFs, 2006 on; frozen 2026-10-30 (any change restarts the forward record)

card.intended_use: Forecast each book ETF's volatility over the next 21 trading days so Trend + Carry 2.1 can size positions by forecast risk instead of trailing 60-day volatility. It forecasts risk, not returns, and is not used for direction, timing or any other book.
card.training_window: 2006-01-03 to 2026-09-30, 116,151 ETF-days pooled across 23 ETFs; frozen 2026-10-30 (model sha256 9650e018).
card.features: 36 inputs in nine groups: last week's, month's and quarter's realised and range-based volatility; VIX and VVIX; the VIX term structure (VIX9D, VIX3M, VIX futures); each ETF's own implied volatility where Cboe publishes one (9 of 23); the FOMC calendar; trading volume; asset class. All dated at the close they are known.
failure_modes: Sudden regime jumps: 2020 alone is 37% of the out-of-sample forecast loss (QLIKE) in 2012-2023, one year of twelve. Forecasts catch up within weeks, not days.
Under-forecasts in shocks: the 80% band covered 76% of outcomes in its 2024-12 to 2026-08 backfill, and about 50% around the April 2025 sell-off.
Inputs outside the training range: trees extrapolate flat, so a VIX or volatility level beyond 2006-2026 extremes is forecast as the nearest extreme seen.
The book-level gain is unproven: forecast skill passed the held-back test (QLIKE +27.5% vs 60-day vol, DM p 0.00076) but the Sharpe gain did not (P(ΔSharpe > 0) 0.50 on the held-back years).
monitoring: Daily attribution: TreeSHAP contributions per ETF, grouped, against the ETF's usual forecast.
Daily 80% split-conformal band from the latest 252 sessions of matured errors; coverage tracked live.
Weekly drift: PSI per feature against training deciles (0.10 moderate, 0.25 drift) and the share of live values outside the training 1st-99th percentile range (flag above 10%).
Forward scoreboard: QLIKE against 60-day vol on every forecast whose 21-day outcome is complete.
card.retraining: None while the forward record runs: any change restarts it. Review at 63 trading days, then monthly; promotion needs 126 days and six rebalances (v52-F kickoff §4). A retrain, if any, is a new pre-registered version with its own forward record.
card.built_with: Code written with AI coding assistants under Sam's direction and review; pre-registered in reports/v52-F_kickoff.md.
